drafted_from: workflow:find-moments-in-a-recording's row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (its input schema, steps and submit shapes)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:find-moments-in-a-recording on the recording 1f:ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12ab12, a 62-second Saturday morning bake clip."

lists.label: Recording moments
lists.holds: One timed stretch of a recording, with what was heard or seen there.

values.evidence: Transcript words 12.0-18.5 s; picture at 15 s shows the counter with the order tray.
Picture at 43 s shows twenty boxes stacked; no speech in this stretch.

alike: a clip log in a spreadsheet

lists.label: Recording pieces
lists.holds: One recording, named by its content identity, with its length and what was inspected.

values.coverage: 0-62.4 s: transcript heard whole; pictures at 0, 12, 30 and 60 s.
0-41 s: no speech; pictures at 0, 20 and 40 s.

instructions: 1. Pour the example rows into the list where you log clips (see pour), or let the moments step make list:recording-moments and list:recording-pieces.
2. Say "Run workflow:find-moments-in-a-recording" with the recording's content identity (1f: and 64 hex characters) as file.

3. The AI works inspect, moments and content: it hears the whole recording, looks at real pictures at explicit seconds, keeps each moment as a timed row with its evidence, and drafts content only from words actually heard.
4. Read the drafts it kept as status Draft in your content list; nothing is posted.

worked_examples.title: A spoken line becomes a timed moment row
worked_examples.ask: Find the moments in my Saturday clip.
worked_examples.given: The inspect step answered duration 62.4 and words "Pre-orders turned our Saturday around." heard from 12.0 to 18.5 s, with a picture taken at 15 s showing the counter and the order tray. The moments step keeps one piece row for the recording and one moment row with 0 <= start < end <= 62.4. Read from the moments step of the workflow row.
worked_examples.hands_back: The submit shape of step moments: {"source_row":"recording-pieces/sat-morning-clip","moments":[{"row":"recording-moments/ab12-12-18","start":12.0,"end":18.5,"evidence":"Transcript words 12.0-18.5 s; picture at 15 s shows the counter with the order tray."}]}

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
